column1: # ASDify offline install destinations. Snapshot checked 2026-10-08.
# 79 upstream agent mappings; cursor renamed cursor-skill to preserve the legacy rule command.
# Local compatibility IDs: claude (claude-code alias), cursor and cursor-rule (compact rule).
# Skill paths are container directories: the installer appends /asdify. Rule paths are complete filenames.
# User roots are explicit placeholders, never shell-evaluated. '-' means unsupported scope.
